versions.boundary_condition: Applies only as a non-exclusive airline preference; United is favored only among otherwise suitable options and may coexist with other acceptable preferred carriers.
versions.condition: When searching for commercial flights and no stronger current-trip carrier instruction overrides this preference.
versions.default_action: Give United positive ranking weight and include United among preferred carrier options when otherwise comparable, while still considering other suitable airlines.
versions.exception_condition: If United is unavailable, worse on primary itinerary constraints such as nonstop/timing/class, materially less attractive, or the user explicitly requests another carrier for the current trip, use or present the better alternative.
versions.name: soft_united_preferred_carrier
versions.preference_value: United is a soft preferred/acceptable airline, not an exclusive carrier requirement.
versions.scope_condition: Applies when Erin is choosing commercial flights for work, conferences, or personal travel from or back to Denver and no current trip instruction fixes another carrier.

versions.boundary_condition: Applies only to flight departure time-of-day. Do not infer it for arrival times, dates, routes, every leg automatically, or earliest-afternoon departures as a recurring rule.
versions.condition: When selecting or comparing flight departure times.
versions.default_action: Look first for departure options in the afternoon; follow any current explicit request for another time window or exact time.
versions.exception_condition: If acceptable afternoon departures are unavailable or conflict with other stated constraints, ask before broadening to nearby time windows.
versions.name: prefers_afternoon_departures
versions.preference_value: Prefers flight departures in the afternoon when no different departure-time constraint is specified.
versions.scope_condition: Applies when Erin is comparing flight options and the current trip does not impose a different departure-time window.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not infer that the user always wants nonstop first, wants a layover for price reasons, or wants to add a stop to break up a long route unless the current request says so.
versions.condition: When evaluating flight itineraries where a connection is acceptable, necessary, or being considered.
versions.default_action: Favor itineraries with at most one short layover; ask before selecting itineraries with multiple layovers or a long layover.
versions.exception_condition: Override this default if the user explicitly requests nonstop only, requests a longer stopover, or prioritizes schedule, availability, price, or another constraint over layover count or layover duration.
versions.name: flight_single_short_layover_preference
versions.preference_value: Prefers connecting itineraries with no more than one layover, and for any layover to be short enough for a comfortable transfer rather than prolonged.
versions.scope_condition: Applies when a nonstop flight is not selected or when connecting itineraries are being compared for her domestic work, conference, family, or leisure trips.

versions.boundary_condition: Applies only to seat location. If seat selection is unavailable at booking or is deferred until check-in, note that limitation and try to secure a window seat at the earliest available time.
versions.condition: When booking or selecting seats for flights where a seat location preference can be applied.
versions.default_action: Prefer or request a window seat by default.
versions.exception_condition: Use a different seat only if the user specifies another seat preference, needs a different seating arrangement, or no acceptable window seat is available.
versions.name: prefers_window_seat_on_flights
versions.scope_condition: Applies when Erin or the assistant can choose or request a seat on flights she is taking.

versions.boundary_condition: This is a soft customer/review-rating default, not an exact 4-star-only rule, not a hotel-class-star requirement, and not a reusable 4.5-star or 3.5-star threshold by itself.
versions.condition: When searching for hotels and a Google rating, review score, or similar customer-facing rating is available, especially for nice, upscale, resort-style, or high-rated stays.
versions.default_action: Filter or rank toward hotels with customer-facing ratings of at least 4.0 stars and report the rating source when known.
versions.exception_condition: If the user specifies a different threshold, prioritizes a budget stay with an explicit lower floor such as 3.5 stars, asks for the cheapest option regardless of quality, only suitable options fall below 4.0, or the rating metric is unclear, follow or clarify the current trip-specific instruction instead of hard-enforcing the 4.0 default.
versions.name: hotel_four_star_customer_rating_floor
versions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with clearly good customer-facing ratings, normally at least 4.0 stars, while treating higher ratings such as 4.5 as a bonus and lower stated floors as trip-specific exceptions.
versions.scope_condition: Applies when Erin is searching for or comparing hotels outside of a mandatory event room block or host-selected lodging.

versions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a reusable hotel-amenity preference, not a destination, date, price, restaurant/bar, or indoor/outdoor pool preference. Use it as soft unless the current request makes the amenities mandatory.
versions.condition: When selecting or evaluating hotel options.
